scenarios.name: Orders sandbox operating evidence
scenarios.summary: A fictional orders workload team reviews supplied EC2 launch details, transfers orders-release.zip in an approved sandbox S3 bucket, and compares QueueDepth metric identities in Lab/Orders. All resource identifiers, locations, permissions evidence and values are authored exercise fixtures; no cloud resources or credentials are provisioned. Learners inspect the evidence rather than execute operations.

assets.title: Approved launch choices and observed EC2 details
assets.description: Read-only fictional launch evidence. The approved row is a request, not a second instance. Null instance ID, state and checks on that row mean not yet observed. The single created instance matches the supplied choices; running state and an impaired instance status check remain separate observations. No health diagnosis or role-policy configuration is implied.

assets.title: Published and queried QueueDepth identities
assets.description: Read-only fictional metric evidence with exactly the two published dimension combinations from the glossary. Values 7 and 3 are authored supplied publication values, not live observations or thresholds. Query rows record requested identities only, not query results. A null Service on the incomplete query means the dimension is omitted; it is not a third publication. Null values on query rows mean no observed value is asserted.
